id.description: A unique ID for the VPS Instance.

ram.description: The amount of RAM in MB.

disk.description: The size of the disk in GB.

region.description: The [Region id](#operation/list-regions) where the Instance is located.

default_password.description: The default password assigned at deployment.

date_created.description: The date this instance was created.

status.description:
The current status.

* active
* halted
* rebooting
* resizing

netmask_v4.description: The IPv4 netmask in dot-decimal notation.

network_size.description: The IPv6 network size in bits.

label.description: The user-supplied label for this instance.

tag.description: The user-supplied tag for this instance.

internal_ip.description: The [user data](https://www.vultr.com/docs/manage-instance-user-data-with-the-vultr-metadata-api) that can be supplied for tools such as cloudinit.

kvm.description: HTTPS link to the Vultr noVNC Web Console.

os_id.description: The [Operating System id](#operation/list-os) used by this instance.

app_id.description: The [Application id](#operation/list-applications) used by this instance.

image_id.description: The [Application image_id](#operation/list-applications) used by this instance.

firewall_group_id.description: The [Firewall Group id](#operation/list-firewall-groups) linked to this Instance.

plan.description: A unique ID for the Plan.
